issues.description: docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-026.md's AC4 own-case construction ("call withdrawRegistration... before calling makeReminder24hJob(...).run(evaluationTime)") does not actually land the withdrawal in the gap it claims to -- selectRegistrationsForReminder24h is a live SQL query re-evaluated at run() call time, not a snapshot taken earlier, so withdrawing the sole candidate before run() simply excludes it from selection (produced 0 ledger rows when run literally as specified, confirmed by direct execution), indistinguishable from AC4's own already-covered 'excluded from selection entirely' case and never exercising composeMessage's own at-send-time recheck. This run reconstructed the case (same acceptance intent, own fixture: two registrations, the second withdrawn as a side effect of the first's own sender.send resolving) to genuinely reach the property under test, and it now passes. Recommend TEST-DESIGNER correct the spec's own construction on a future revision.

This run's own authoring mistake (fixed before this report, not a spec defect): the first draft of AC7's own-fixture case reused the shared seedAdmittedRegistration helper, which hardcodes the registrant's own lang to 'ru' -- since resolveLang derives the resolved lang from the registrant's own user record (not the chapter's defaultLang alone), this silently produced a Russian-language caption despite the chapter being seeded with defaultLang 'en', failing the exact-substring assertion against the English-formatted expectedDoorsText. Fixed by seeding this case's own registrant directly with lang: 'en' via resolveOrCreateUser + registerForEvent, matching the spec's own stated intent.
